newsitem.title: USA: Andersen says wins $1.87-mln claim against Beverly.
newsitem.headline: Andersen says wins $1.87-mln claim against Beverly.

text.p: Andersen Consulting said it won a $1.87-million claim against Beverly Enterprises Inc covering Andersen's legal fees and expenses from a dispute involving a business office computer system.

Andersen said a federal jury in Fort Smith, Ark., awarded the claim to Andersen and found the consulting firm "not liable on charges of negligence, fraud and breaches of contract and fiduciary duty ... (and) dismissed Beverly's claim for professional malpractice."
Beverly had sued Andersen alleging fraud relating to a contract to develop a business office system. Andersen said it counter-sued alleging breach of contract by Beverly.
Andersen said that in 1994 it was hired by Beverly to develop the new system and had completed most of the work when the project was abruptly terminated.
Beverly could not be reached for comment.
